page.layout: One page of text, single column. Page number at the top right. Below the text: a centred heading "FINIS.", then a woodcut ornament (no text), then a catchword "ERRA-" at the lower right.

main_text.p: qua felegit, quæ fufciperet Officia, quæ deferet: quam feleCtionem cum ratio non dedert, necessum est, ut illam sibi libido assumpserit.
main_text.head: FINIS.

page.notes: The page number is printed as "195" in an old-style numeral form (rendered here as 195). The line "assumpserit." is printed with the catchword-like word "assumpserit." followed by a stop. The woodcut ornament below FINIS has no text. Some words in the first line are uncertain due to scan quality: "felegit" may be "selegit" and "feleCtionem" may read "seleCtionem"; I have transcribed them as printed to the best of my reading. The first line of the scan begins with "qua" and the text as printed is "qua felegit, quæ sufciperet Officia, quæ deferet: quam feleCtionem cum ratio non dedert, necessum est, ut illam sibi libido assumpserit."
